arxiv-2008-09990.title: Unsupervised Multi-view Clustering by Squeezing Hybrid Knowledge from Cross View and Each View
arxiv-2008-09990.creator: Junpeng Tan, Yukai Shi, Zhijing Yang, Caizhen Wen, Liang Lin
arxiv-2008-09990.description: Abstract Multi-view clustering methods have been a focus in recent years because of their superiority in clustering performance. However, typical traditional multi-view clustering algorithms still have shortcomings in some aspects, such as removal of redundant information, utilization of various views and fusion of multi-view features.

arxiv-2203-11107.title: F F -algebroids and deformation quantization via pre-Lie algebroids
arxiv-2203-11107.creator: John Alexander Cruz Morales, Jiefeng Liu, Yunhe Sheng
arxiv-2203-11107.description: Abstract . In this paper, first we introduce a new approach to the notion of F F -algebroids, which is a generalization of F F -manifold algebras and F F -manifolds, and show that F F -algebroids are the corresponding semi-classical limits of pre-Lie formal deformations of commutative associative algebroids.

arxiv-2204-12769.title: Dynamic Registration: Joint Ego Motion Estimation and 3D Moving Object Detection in Dynamic Environment
arxiv-2204-12769.creator: Wenyu Li, Xinyu Zhang, Zijun Wang, Shichun Guo, Nan Qiu, Jun Li
arxiv-2204-12769.description: Abstract Localization in a dynamic environment suffers from moving objects. Removing dynamic object is crucial in this situation but become tricky when ego-motion is coupled. In this paper, instead of proposing a new slam framework, we aim at a more general strategy for a localization scenario. In that case, Dynamic Registration is available for integrating with any lidar slam system.

arxiv-2205-05405.title: Existence and Consistency of the Maximum Pseudo β \beta -Likelihood Estimators for Multivariate Normal Mixture Models
arxiv-2205-05405.creator: Soumya Chakraborty, Ayanendranath Basu, Abhik Ghosh
arxiv-2205-05405.description: Abstract Robust estimation under multivariate normal (MVN) mixture model is always a computational challenge. A recently proposed maximum pseudo β \beta -likelihood estimator aims to estimate the unknown parameters of a MVN mixture model in the spirit of minimum density power divergence (DPD) methodology but with a relatively simpler and tractable computational algorithm even for larger dimensions.

arxiv-2210-16825.title: Heavy quark symmetry of Λ b 0 \Lambda_{b}^{0} decays in quark models
arxiv-2210-16825.creator: Jiabao Zhang, Xiang-Nan Jin, Chia-Wei Liu and Chao-Qiang Geng
arxiv-2210-16825.description: Abstract We study the heavy quark symmetry with the homogeneous bag model (HBM) and light-front quark model (LFQM) based on the decays of Λ b 0 → Λ c + ​ ℓ − ​ ν ¯ ℓ ​ ( ℓ = e , μ , τ ) \Lambda_{b}^{0}\to\Lambda_{c}^{+}\ell^{-}\overline{\nu}_{\ell}~(\ell=e,\mu,\tau) .

arxiv-2410-05027.title: Bi-Directional MS Lesion Filling and Synthesis Using Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model-based Lesion Repainting
arxiv-2410-05027.creator: Jinwei Zhang ∗, Lianrui Zuo ∗, Yihao Liu, Samuel Remedios, Bennett A. Landman, Jerry L. Prince, Aaron Carass
arxiv-2410-05027.description: Abstract Automatic magnetic resonance (MR) image processing pipelines are widely used to study people with multiple sclerosis (PwMS), encompassing tasks such as lesion segmentation and brain parcellation. However, the presence of lesion often complicates these analysis, particularly in brain parcellation.

arxiv-2411-12651.title: First-principle theory of the Casimir screening effect The authors dedicate this article to the memory of Professor Rudolf Podgornik, who passed away suddenly, leaving a significant void in the field of theoretical physics. His contributions and discussions have enriched not only the current work, b
arxiv-2411-12651.creator: Yury A. Budkov, Petr E. Brandyshev
arxiv-2411-12651.description: Abstract In this paper, we use the formalism of finite-temperature quantum field theory to investigate the Casimir force between flat, ideally conductive surfaces containing confined, but mobile ions. We demonstrate that, in the Gaussian approximation, the ionic fluctuations contribute separately from the electromagnetic fluctuations that are responsible for the standard Casimir effect.

arxiv-2505-20762.title: The Extreme Universe Observatory on a Super-Pressure Balloon II: Mission, Payload, and Flight
arxiv-2505-20762.creator: R. Young
arxiv-2505-20762.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by R. Young. The Extreme Universe Space Observatory on a Super Pressure Balloon 2 (EUSO-SPB2) is a pathfinder mission toward a space-based observatory such as the Probe of Extreme Multi-Messenger Astrophysics (POEMMA). The aim of POEMMA is the observation of Ultra High Energy COsmic Rays (UHECRs) in order to elucidate their nature and origins and to discover ≳ \gtrsim 20 PeV very high energy neutrinos that originate from transient and steady astrophysical sources.

arxiv-2507-06665.title: Distributions based on Stable Mixtures and Gamma-Stable Convolutions
arxiv-2507-06665.creator: Nomvelo Karabo Sibisi sbsnom005@myuct.ac.za
arxiv-2507-06665.description: Abstract This paper explores mixture distributions induced by a product of the positive stable random variable and a power of another positive random variable. The paper also considers the convolution of the stable density with a gamma density. These two constructs, mixing and convolution, suffice to generate a rich family of distributions.

arxiv-2508-12164.title: An Efficient Network-aware Direct Search Method for Influence Maximization
arxiv-2508-12164.creator: Matteo Bergamaschi, Sara Venturini, Francesco Tudisco, Francesco Rinaldi
arxiv-2508-12164.description: Abstract Influence Maximization (IM) is a pivotal concept in social network analysis, involving the identification of influential nodes within a network to maximize the number of influenced nodes, and has a wide variety of applications that range from viral marketing and information dissemination to public health campaigns.

arxiv-2601-08965.title: Newell-Whitehead-Segel equation, A Simpler Proof
arxiv-2601-08965.creator: Luisiana X. Cundin
arxiv-2601-08965.description: Abstract Previous analysis of the Newell-Whitehead-Segel equation proved the best solution is null; although, the method of solution generated complex nested integrals, therefore, difficult to analyze [ 3 , 2 ] . Recent insights into the properties of the convolution integral enable considerable simplification of the solution in the codomain, producing much simpler representations.

pmc-10735585.creator: Amanda Leggett, Sophia Tsuker
pmc-10735585.description: Existing research points toward higher burden for spousal, and particularly wife, caregivers for persons living with dementia (PLwD). Yet how relationship roles and stressors shifted during the COVID-19 pandemic, where some care dyads were isolated together, or physically distancing, is unknown. The current study explores how the variability in reports of COVID-specific care-related stress (e.g.

pmc-11436719.title: Pixel to practice: multi-scale image data for calibrating remote-sensing-based winter wheat monitoring methods
pmc-11436719.creator: Jonas Anderegg, Flavian Tschurr, Norbert Kirchgessner, Simon Treier, Lukas Valentin Graf, Manuel Schmucki, Nicolin Caflisch, Camille Minguely, Bernhard Streit, Achim Walter
pmc-11436719.description: Site-specific crop management in heterogeneous fields has emerged as a promising avenue towards increasing agricultural productivity whilst safeguarding the environment. However, successful implementation is hampered by insufficient availability of accurate spatial information on crop growth, vigor, and health status at large scales.

pmc-11561305.title: Phage biocontrol success of bacterial wilt depends on synergistic interactions with resident rhizosphere microbiota
pmc-11561305.creator: Sara Franco Ortega, Bryden Fields, Daniel Narino Rojas, Lauri Mikonranta, Matthew Holmes, Andrea L. Harper, Ville‐Petri Friman
pmc-11561305.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Phages can successfully be used in vitro and in planta to biocontrol the phytopathogenic Ralstonia solanacearum bacterium—the causal agent of bacterial wilt disease. However, phage biocontrol outcomes are still variable, and it is unclear what causes this. In this study, we assessed the efficiency of four phages in controlled in vitro and in planta experiments in all one‐ and two‐phage combinations.

pmc-12656103.title: Optimisation of a One-Step Reusable Immuno-Affinity Purification Method for the Analysis and Detection of Fumonisin Mycotoxins in Foods and Feeds
pmc-12656103.creator: Christian Kosisochukwu Anumudu
pmc-12656103.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Fumonisins are among the most prevalent mycotoxins in maize and maize-based products, posing significant food safety and public health risks due to their hepatotoxic, nephrotoxic, and potential carcinogenic effects. Given the strict regulatory limits set by the European Commission and Codex Alimentarius, the development of reliable, sensitive, and matrix–robust analytical methods remain a priority for routine monitoring in both food and feed systems.

pmc-13091479.title: Microbial transmission among giant panda, sympatric wildlife, and domesticated animals
pmc-13091479.creator: Hairong He, Shuting Liu, Han Han, Hong Zhou, Yuxiang Chen, Huawei Tian, Minghua Chen, Wei Wei
pmc-13091479.description: SummaryThe gut microbiome of wild animals is subject to complex influences, including cross-species transmission that risks host and environmental health. This study used 16S rRNA sequencing to profile microbial communities in giant pandas (GPs), sympatric wildlife, domesticated animals, and environmental samples from panda habitats. Results revealed significant differences in microbial community structure at both phylum and genus levels.

pmc-13207553.title: Characterization of Seminal Plasma Extracellular Vesicle MicroRNAs and Their Association with Boar Semen Quality During the Summer Season
pmc-13207553.creator: Notsile H. Dlamini, Serge L. Kameni, Shengfa F. Liao, Jean M. Feugang
pmc-13207553.description: Boar fertility is negatively affected by subfertility and elevated temperatures, which alter seminal plasma (SP) composition and reduce semen quality. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) in SP transfer microRNAs (miRNAs) to sperm and may influence sperm function. This study aimed to identify SP-EV microRNAs associated with differences in boar semen quality during the summer season.

pmc-13404198.title: Associations Between Solitary Masturbation Parameters and Sexual Arousal in Partnered Sexual Activity
pmc-13404198.creator: Gracia M. Sánchez-Pérez, Juan Carlos Sierra
pmc-13404198.description: Given the limited empirical evidence regarding the relationship between masturbation and sexual functioning, this study aimed to examine the association between multiple masturbation parameters—age of first masturbation, negative attitudes toward masturbation, solitary sexual desire, current frequency, and the intensity of the subjective orgasm experience—and self-reported sexual arousal within partnered sexual activity.

pmc-13448172.title: Sugar reduction in complex food systems: linking metabolic mechanisms, matrix engineering, and safety evaluation
pmc-13448172.creator: Huimin Xue, Kexin Hong, Xiping Kang, Yunxiao Gao, Yunyu Tang, Weidong Huang, Jicheng Zhan, Jia Liu, Yilin You
pmc-13448172.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Excessive intake of rapidly absorbable sugars challenges metabolic regulation beyond caloric imbalance. Glucose and fructose differ in absorption kinetics and hepatic metabolic pathways, leading to distinct effects on glycemic dynamics, de novo lipogenesis, insulin signaling, and microbiota–host interactions. Emerging evidence further indicates that sugar bioavailability and metabolic outcomes are strongly influenced by food matrix structure, physicochemical interactions, and processing-induced microstructural changes.
